description: Two independent toggle flip flops, each flipping its output between high and low on every rising edge it is given

inputs.text: Each rising edge over 2V here flips that flip flop's Q output between 10V and 0V, and its NOT Q output the other way, as long as that flip flop is enabled
A gate over 2V here forces that flip flop's Q output to 0V and its NOT Q output to 10V, and holds them there while it stays high, as long as that flip flop is enabled
With nothing patched here, that flip flop answers its T and RESET inputs at all times; with a cable patched, a gate over 2V must be present here for them to have any effect

outputs.text: Flips between 10V and 0V on each rising edge at T, and is forced to 0V by RESET; the level is saved with the patch
Flips between 0V and 10V on each rising edge at T, and is forced to 10V by RESET; it is always the opposite of Q
